result.topic_en: Notes on a series solution $u=\sum \sin K_n \sin n\frac{\pi y}{2\beta}(\ldots)$ for a potential/current-flow problem satisfying boundary conditions 1-3, with a remark on Du Bois-Reymond's assumption about the entry point of current in a cylinder and an image-type series of terms $\frac{2m\beta\pm\alpha}{\sqrt{rr+(2m\beta\pm\alpha)^2}^3}$.
